tool_args.rationale: Five observations share one fixed context and vary only u_now. The supplied verified note describes a two-layer siphon, while the signatures indicate bridge bullwhip and flux conservation; those rows alone do not identify its coupled dynamics at the forecast horizon. The cheaper open-branch discriminating probe is the targeted next measurement.

Higher cost than the open-branch probe; current data call for mechanism discrimination, not denser sampling of the same branch.
Nuisance data do not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
